title: Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program: Posting the Late Pickup Fee
content:
**Policy.** The Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program prices the late pickup fee of the enrollment's most recently recorded chargeable late pickup. The fee of a late pickup is posted before the fee of any later late pickup, and an enrollment with no chargeable late pickup has no fee to price.

**Charge.** Every late pickup other than a waived first incident is still chargeable and posts one late pickup fee. A late pickup of the 2026-27 school year is priced by the board-approved 2026-27 late pickup fee schedule. A late pickup of any other school year still posts a late pickup fee of its minutes late multiplied by the program's late pickup fee per minute.

**What posting does.** Posting books one late pickup fee entry on the enrollment's billing history for the day of care of that late pickup, dated the day it is posted. The enrollment's balance due goes up by the fee, and the fee then shows in the billing history next to that day of care.

## Invocation: `post_late_pickup_fee_6e670263`

`post_late_pickup_fee_6e670263` is an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks it and then calls it. One call books one late pickup fee entry.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `care_enrollment_id` | the Extended Day enrollment reference number of the student who was picked up late, as returned by the Extended Day enrollment lookup | identifier |
| `service_date` | the day of care of the late pickup, exactly as shown on the late pickup entry in the enrollment's attendance log lookup | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `fee_amount` | the fee in US dollars | a positive amount with at most 2 decimal places, already rounded to the cent, half a cent rounding up; zero or negative amounts are not accepted |

**Return.** On success the tool returns a confirmation sentence. It names the new fee entry's reference number (text beginning `clp_`), the enrollment reference number, the day of care (YYYY-MM-DD), the fee in dollars with two decimals and the posting date (YYYY-MM-DD). Its presence means the fee is booked.

**Errors.** A sentence beginning "Error:" means nothing was booked. The tool returns one when the fee amount is not a positive dollar amount with at most two decimal places, when the day of care is not written YYYY-MM-DD, or when no Extended Day enrollment has the reference number given.

## Illustration (hypothetical values)

A call with enrollment reference `CE-EXAMPLE`, day of care 2030-02-14 and fee 12.34 returns a sentence naming a new `clp_` entry of 12.34 for 2030-02-14, posted on the current date to enrollment `CE-EXAMPLE`. A call with a fee of 12.345 returns an error, and nothing is booked.
